_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Arise, shine; your light has come.
The glory of the Lord has risen upon us.
The magi followed a star out of the east.
We have come to kneel before the King.
Darkness covers the earth and its peoples.
But over us the light of God is dawning.
Come, let us worship and bring our gifts.
Arise, shine; your light has come. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Lift up your eyes and look around: a star has risen over the long dark, and travelers are coming from far countries to its light.
Arise, shine; your light has come!
Darkness still covers the earth, thick darkness the peoples, but the glory of the Lord has dawned upon you.
Arise, shine; your light has come!
The magi knelt where the star stopped and opened their treasures — gold and frankincense and myrrh laid before a child.
Arise, shine; your light has come!
So we follow the light to the place where he is and offer all we have. Come, let us adore him.
Arise, shine; your light has come! Amen.
